text:
rachel: quick thought  propose the gateway emits a tiny "lease" token + optional progressive hints so clients can decide: keep spinner, show partial, or attempt fallback. elastic UI decisions instead of opaque timeouts.

dom: curious — what's the minimal wire? headers only, trailers, or NDJSON events inline? also worried about cache hits making clients flip state.

maria: minimal opt-in proposal: header `X-RW-Progress: enabled=true` and `X-RW-Lease: id=uuid;priority=high|normal|low;attempt=1`. For streams, gateway can emit sparse ndjson lines like `{ "lease_id":"...", "stage":"first_token|partial|final", "bucket":50 }`. Keep bucket coarse.

akshay: admission sketch: score = base_score - priority_penalty - age_penalty. Reserve a soft-share (eg 15%) concurrency for high priority so we don't preempt in-flight high calls. Low priority can be preempted only before `first_token` stage.

olivia: observability: add span tags `progress.lease_id`, `progress.stage`, `progress.attempt`. Metrics: `progress.emitted`, `progress.missing`, `time_to_first_progress.p95`. Use sampling flag to avoid cardinality explosions. Emit model_variant only on stage transitions.

dom: cache behavior: if gateway serves cached prefix, emit `stage=final; source=cache` immediately. Make it explicit so UI doesn't show spinner.

infra-bot: FYI: feature flag `lease-progress-v1` branch created; CI passes on staging at 1748410100.

rachel: concrete next steps: (1) prototype headers + ndjson emitter behind `lease-progress-v1` on chat-beta (owner: @akshay), (2) wire minimal SDK hooks to interpret lease_id and stage (owner: @maria), (3) olivia to add spans/alerts, (4) dom to propose soft-share numbers and eviction bounds. I'll draft RFC follow-up with enum values and privacy opt-out notes. :thumbsup:
